name: 侠客新传 (New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman)
english_name: New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman
english_description: A wuxia mudlib developed by the "Xkxz MUD Wizard Group." A leftover "Ocean II Shanghai Main Site" field in its config file suggests the code was likely built as a second-generation development on top of the "Ocean II" engine, though the actual game content and login banner present it as an independent title. The game opens at a "Peach Blossom Spring" paradise-like starting scene and blends character archetypes (Warrior, Wisdom, Endurance, Agility, Balanced) with sect martial arts for its wuxia progression system. Distinctively, a new character does not immediately "reincarnate" after basic registration — players must find the NPC Shuisheng in-game and complete `register <email>` before choosing their aptitude and gaining full stats, an intentional onboarding design rather than a bug.
